about: ADR-0101 agora-approval-always-v1: the signed bytes of an "always" decision (`ApprovalResolve.scope` = APPROVAL_SCOPE_ALWAYS, approved) on an approval an agent's adapter asked for. The domain `agora-approval-always-v1`, one NUL byte, then F(node_id) F(approval_id) F(verdict) F(agent_id) F(sha256(action)) F(sha256(detail)) F(always_label) F(always_option_id), concatenated, where F(x) is the decimal byte length of x (UTF-8 bytes), `:`, then x (no separators between fields). verdict is always `1` (an always decision is never a denial). `agent_id` is the node's own id of the agent (`ApprovalRequested.agent_id` as the node sent it; in an `ApprovalSnapshot` the part after `<node_id>/`); the hashes are SHA-256 of `action` and `detail` exactly as announced, lowercase hex; `always_label` and `always_option_id` are `ApprovalRequested.always_label` and `always_option_id` exactly as announced. A decision with scope UNSPECIFIED or ONCE is signed over `agora-approval-v1` as before. Checked by crates/agora-protocol/tests/approval_always_signing.rs and the node (crates/agora-node/src/approvals.rs).

cases.name: an always answer to a command
an always-only request, the agent's label empty
fields with a colon, a space, a non-ASCII letter and an empty detail
